confidence_notes: I couldn't find any aggregated price index specific to Munnar. The food and drink anchors therefore combine a few Munnar travel-budget figures with proxy cost-of-living figures for Kochi, Kottayam and the nearby hill towns of Coonoor and Valparai. One search result attributed some of the Kochi figures to Numbeo, but I couldn't open Numbeo's page directly. Most proxy sites were undated, and one was last updated in July 2023. I raised the meal and coffee anchors above the very low proxy figures because Munnar is a tourist hill station with tourist-oriented cafes and restaurants, so prices are higher. Beer is the least certain food and drink anchor. Kerala licensing means beer is mostly served at licensed hotel bars and restaurants, and those prices are well above the retail shelf prices I found for Kochi. I didn't find direct cocktail or wine prices. Those two anchors are bounded estimates based on beer prices and typical Kerala hotel-bar markups, and they could be off by plus or minus 40%. The accommodation anchors are general-knowledge estimates for July, which is monsoon low season. I didn't check them against live listings. Hostel availability in Munnar is limited, so the hostel dorm and private-room anchors are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: I scaled up proxy prices from Kochi and Kottayam in Kerala and from Coonoor and Valparai, two Western Ghats hill stations, to allow for Munnar's tourist-town premium. I also checked these against Munnar travel-budget figures for meals and coffee.
